content_items.hook: Your funder wants proof. The proof is spread across folders, spreadsheets and email. Evidex turns that evidence mess into a review-ready pack.
content_items.body:
A controlled messy-input-to-evidence-pack case with mapped claims, provenance, human review, delivery state and business telemetry.

If NASCEE is shown 'Golden Evidex transaction: source intake -> evidence pack -> human approval -> payment/delivery receipt with provenance.', then the M&E/grants/compliance decision-maker is more likely to request a bounded pilot because the offer addresses a specific workflow pain without surrendering human authority.

Call to action: Review the golden case and nominate one bounded evidence-pack pilot.

content_items.hook: One curriculum spine should not produce eight identical-looking papers. Watch HOMS change the assessment architecture with the subject.
content_items.body:
Eight Grade 12 Term 3 subject packs with separate memoranda, source-grounded papers, embedded media and educator approval boundaries.

If ISASA is shown 'Cross-phase live proof: Grade 3 Mathematics activity-style pack vs Grade 10 Dance Studies performance task, each with memo/rubric and educator approval.', then the Academic/curriculum decision-maker is more likely to request a bounded pilot because the offer addresses a specific workflow pain without surrendering human authority.

Call to action: Review the tight-eight proof and request one subject-and-grade pilot.

content_items.hook: One curriculum spine should drive the explanation, activity, worksheet, assessment, memo and optional video lesson.
content_items.body:
HOMS assessment and CAPS controls plus NicheFoundry media production can be combined; a connected one-topic guide, activity, worksheet, assessment, memo and video proof remains the release gate.

If Publishers Association of South Africa (PASA) is shown 'One-topic companion proof: beautiful guided-learning pack + visual resource + practice sheet + HOMS assessment/memo from the same curriculum spine.', then the Curriculum/content decision-maker is more likely to request a bounded pilot because the offer addresses a specific workflow pain without surrendering human authority.

Call to action: Nominate one subject, grade, term and topic for a controlled companion-pack pilot.

content_items.hook: Academic AI should show an author what to strengthen, not write the work for them.
content_items.body:
Grounded Gemini reviewer commentary, technical citation audit and claim-to-source ledger with human approval and academic-integrity boundaries.

If HELTASA is shown 'Authorship-safe research audit: source-fit/citation/format/literature-review critique before-and-after report, with no ghostwriting.', then the Postgraduate/research-support decision-maker is more likely to request a bounded pilot because the offer addresses a specific workflow pain without surrendering human authority.

Call to action: Request one bounded manuscript-section review.

content_items.hook: Performance review panic starts when evidence was never collected as evidence.
content_items.body:
A controlled private proof mapped 190 evidence records to performance objectives, retained review candidates and exposed evidence gaps without making a rating decision.

If Institute of People Management (IPM) is shown 'Fake staff annual-review case: agreement + approved Outlook/file evidence -> KPA/task mapping -> gaps -> human-reviewed performance snapshot.', then the HR/performance-management decision-maker is more likely to request a bounded pilot because the offer addresses a specific workflow pain without surrendering human authority.

principles: DIO owns campaign truth; channels are adapters.
Wave 2 platform integrations are read-first. Ad creation, budget mutation and publication APIs are not exposed.
No spend without an explicit operator budget release.
No publication without proof binding and human approval.
No automated personal DMs or unsolicited bulk electronic sales outreach.
External media and agencies are first-class manual media-buy adapters.
Platform metrics are observations; verified leads, orders and payments remain DIO commercial truth.
Campaign decisions must be based on measured outcomes, not vanity metrics alone.

units.source_text: Community Water Quality Monitoring Procedure
units.target_text: Prosedure vir Gemeenskapswatergehaltemonitering

units.source_text: Purpose: This procedure explains how field teams collect and record drinking water samples so that results are reliable and traceable to the correct site.
units.target_text: Doel: Hierdie prosedure verduidelik hoe veldspanne drinkwatermonsters versamel en aanteken sodat resultate betroubaar is en na die korrekte terrein teruggespoor kan word.

units.source_text: Scope: It applies to routine samples collected from reservoirs, treatment outlets, and public taps. The procedure does not cover emergency chemical spills or laboratory instrument calibration.
units.target_text: Omvang: Dit is van toepassing op roetinemonsters wat by reservoirs, behandelingsuitlate en openbare krane versamel word. Die prosedure dek nie chemiese noodstortings of die kalibrering van laboratoriuminstrumente nie.

units.source_text: Responsibilities: The team leader checks that each technician has PBT, clean sample bottles, and a calibrated meter. Technicians are responsible for completing the Chain of Custody Form QMS-07 and reporting unsafe conditions.
units.target_text: Verantwoordelikhede: Die spanleier kontroleer dat elke tegnikus oor persoonlike beskermende toerusting (PBT), skoon monsterbottels en 'n gekalibreerde meter beskik. Tegnici is verantwoordelik vir die voltooiing van Bewaringskettingvorm QMS-07 en die aanmelding van onveilige toestande.

units.source_text: Procedure: Before collecting a sample, allow the tap to run for 2 minutes. Rinse the probe with clean water, but do not rinse a sterile microbiological bottle. Record pH and turbidity in NTU at the site. Samples must be placed in a cooler between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius.
units.target_text: Prosedure: Laat die kraan 2 minute lank loop voordat 'n monster geneem word. Spoel die sonde met skoon water af, maar moenie 'n steriele mikrobiologiese bottel uitspoel nie. Teken die pH en troebelheid in NTU op die terrein aan. Monsters moet in 'n koelhouer tussen 2 en 8 grade Celsius geplaas word.

units.source_text: Data recording: Write the site code, date, time, and sampler initials on both the bottle and QMS-07. Corrections must be made with a single line through the error; correction fluid is not allowed. The reason for any missing reading must be stated.
units.target_text: Data-aantekening: Skryf die terreinkode, datum, tyd en monsternemer se voorletters op die bottel en QMS-07. Maak regstellings deur 'n enkele streep deur die fout te trek; korreksievloeistof word nie toegelaat nie. Die rede vir enige ontbrekende lesing moet aangedui word.

units.source_text: Escalation: If pH is below 6.5 or above 9.5, or turbidity is higher than 1 NTU, phone the team leader immediately. Do not tell the community that the water is safe or unsafe until the authorised official has reviewed the result.
units.target_text: Eskalering: Indien pH laer as 6.5 of hoër as 9.5 is, of troebelheid hoër as 1 NTU is, skakel die spanleier onmiddellik. Moenie die gemeenskap inlig dat die water veilig of onveilig is voordat die gemagtigde amptenaar die resultaat hersien het nie.

units.target_text: Mokhoa oa ho Lekola Boleng ba Metsi a Sechaba

units.source_text: Purpose: This procedure explains how field teams collect and record drinking water samples so that results are reliable and traceable to the correct site.
units.target_text: Morero: Mokhoa ona o hlalosa hore na lihlopha tsa masimong li bokella le ho ngola mehlala ea metsi a nooang joang e le hore liphetho li tšepahale le ho lateloa ho ea sebakeng se nepahetseng.

units.source_text: Scope: It applies to routine samples collected from reservoirs, treatment outlets, and public taps. The procedure does not cover emergency chemical spills or laboratory instrument calibration.
units.target_text: Sebaka sa tšebeliso: Se sebetsa ho mehlala e tloaelehileng e bokelloang matamong, libakeng tsa phekolo ea metsi, le lipompong tsa sechaba. Mokhoa ona ha o akaretse ho qhalana ha lik'hemik'hale tsa tšohanyetso kapa ho lekanya lisebelisoa tsa laboratori.

units.source_text: Responsibilities: The team leader checks that each technician has PBT, clean sample bottles, and a calibrated meter. Technicians are responsible for completing the Chain of Custody Form QMS-07 and reporting unsafe conditions.
units.target_text: Boikarabelo: Moetapele oa sehlopha o hlahloba hore setekheniki se seng le se seng se na le PBT, libotlolo tse hloekileng tsa mehlala, le metha e lekantsoeng. Lithekheniki li ikarabella ho tlatsa Foromo ea Chain of Custody QMS-07 le ho tlaleha maemo a sa bolokehang.

flags.issue: PBT is not expanded; technicians may not know what it stands for. Consider adding a definition or using a local term for personal protective equipment.

units.source_text: Procedure: Before collecting a sample, allow the tap to run for 2 minutes. Rinse the probe with clean water, but do not rinse a sterile microbiological bottle. Record pH and turbidity in NTU at the site. Samples must be placed in a cooler between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius.
units.target_text: Mokhoa: Pele o bokella sampole, lumella pompo hore e phalle metsi ka metsotso e 2. Hlatsoa probe ka metsi a hloekileng, empa u se ke ua hlatsoa botlolo e sa tšoaetsoang ea likokoana-hloko. Ngola pH le turbidity ka NTU sebakeng seo. Mehlala e tlameha ho behoa ka har'a sehatsetsi pakeng tsa 2 le 8 degrees Celsius.

flags.issue: The term 'probe' is retained in English; ensure technicians understand it refers to the sensor of the meter.
The phrase 'degrees Celsius' is kept in English; consider using 'likhato tsa Celsius' for clarity.

units.source_text: Data recording: Write the site code, date, time, and sampler initials on both the bottle and QMS-07. Corrections must be made with a single line through the error; correction fluid is not allowed. The reason for any missing reading must be stated.
units.target_text: Ho ngola data: Ngola khoutu ea sebaka, letsatsi, nako, le litlhaku tsa motho ea nkang sampole botlolong le ho QMS-07. Litokiso li tlameha ho etsoa ka mola o le mong ho tšela phoso; ha ho lumelloe ho sebelisa mokelikeli oa ho lokisa. Lebaka la ho se baloe ho itseng le tlameha ho boleloa.

units.source_text: Escalation: If pH is below 6.5 or above 9.5, or turbidity is higher than 1 NTU, phone the team leader immediately. Do not tell the community that the water is safe or unsafe until the authorised official has reviewed the result.
units.target_text: Ho nyolla taba: Haeba pH e ka tlase ho 6.5 kapa e kaholimo ho 9.5, kapa turbidity e phahame ho feta 1 NTU, letsetsa moetapele oa sehlopha hang-hang. U se ke ua bolella sechaba hore metsi a bolokehile kapa ha a bolokeha ho fihlela ofisiri e lumelletsoeng e hlahlobile sephetho.

units.source_text: Community Water Quality Monitoring Procedure
units.target_text: Mokgwa wa go Lekola Boleng jwa Metsi a Setšhaba

units.source_text: Purpose: This procedure explains how field teams collect and record drinking water samples so that results are reliable and traceable to the correct site.
units.target_text: Maikaelelo: Mokgwa o o tlhalosa gore ditlhopha tsa kwa ntle di kgobokanya le go kwala disampole tsa metsi a go nwa jang gore dipholo di nne tse di tshephegang le tse di ka latelwang kwa lefelong le le siameng.

units.source_text: Scope: It applies to routine samples collected from reservoirs, treatment outlets, and public taps. The procedure does not cover emergency chemical spills or laboratory instrument calibration.
units.target_text: Kakaretso: O dira ka disampole tsa tlwaelo tse di tserweng mo matamong, mo mafelong a go alafa metsi, le mo dipompong tsa setšhaba. Mokgwa o ga o akaretse tshetleho ya dikhemikale tsa tshoganetso kgotsa go lekanyetsa didirisiwa tsa kwa laboratoring.

units.source_text: Responsibilities: The team leader checks that each technician has PBT, clean sample bottles, and a calibrated meter. Technicians are responsible for completing the Chain of Custody Form QMS-07 and reporting unsafe conditions.
units.target_text: Maikarabelo: Moeteledipele wa setlhopha o tlhatlhoba gore motekheniki mongwe le mongwe o na le PBT, dibotlelana tsa disampole tse di phepa, le selekanyetsi se se lekanyeditsweng. Batekheniki ba na le maikarabelo a go tlatsa Foromo ya QMS-07 ya Chain of Custody le go bega maemo a a sa bolokehang.

flags.issue: The term 'Chain of Custody' is a legal/administrative concept; ensure the translation conveys the formal tracking process. Consider adding a brief explanation if needed.

units.source_text: Procedure: Before collecting a sample, allow the tap to run for 2 minutes. Rinse the probe with clean water, but do not rinse a sterile microbiological bottle. Record pH and turbidity in NTU at the site. Samples must be placed in a cooler between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius.
units.target_text: Mokgwa: Pele o tsaya sampole, letla pompo e elele ka metsotso e 2. Tlhatswa probe ka metsi a a phepa, mme o se ka wa tlhatswa botlhelo jo bo sa bolaeng jwa microbiological. Kwala pH le turbidity ka NTU kwa lefelong. Disampole di tshwanetse go bewa mo setsidifatsing magareng ga 2 le 8 degrees Celsius.

flags.issue: Technical terms 'probe', 'microbiological', 'turbidity', and 'degrees Celsius' are retained in English; verify that this is acceptable for the target audience or if local equivalents exist.

units.source_text: Data recording: Write the site code, date, time, and sampler initials on both the bottle and QMS-07. Corrections must be made with a single line through the error; correction fluid is not allowed. The reason for any missing reading must be stated.
units.target_text: Go kwala datha: Kwala khoutu ya lefelo, letlha, nako, le ditšhupiso tsa motlhatlheledi mo botlhelong le mo QMS-07. Diphoso di tshwanetse go suthisiwa ka mola o le mongwe go ralala phoso; ga go letlelelwe go dirisa setlhotlho sa go phimola. Lebaka la go tlhoka go bala lepe le tshwanetse go tlhalosiwa.

flags.issue: The translation of 'sampler initials' as 'ditšhupiso tsa motlhatlheledi' may not be precise; consider 'ditšhupiso tsa yo o tsayang sampole' for clarity.
The term 'correction fluid' is translated as 'setlhotlho sa go phimola' (eraser fluid); verify that this is the common term in Setswana for correction fluid.

units.source_text: Escalation: If pH is below 6.5 or above 9.5, or turbidity is higher than 1 NTU, phone the team leader immediately. Do not tell the community that the water is safe or unsafe until the authorised official has reviewed the result.
units.target_text: Go oketša: Fa pH e le kwa tlase ga 6.5 kgotsa e feta 9.5, kgotsa turbidity e feta 1 NTU, bitsa moeteledipele wa setlhopha ka bonako. O se ka wa bolelela setšhaba gore metsi a bolokehile kgotsa ga a bolokeha go fitlha lekgetho le le letleletsweng le lekotse dipholo.

flags.issue: The translation of 'authorised official' as 'lekgetho le le letleletsweng' may be ambiguous; consider 'modiri yo o letleletsweng' or 'ofisiri e e letleletsweng' for clarity.

units.source_text: Community Water Quality Monitoring Procedure
units.target_text: Inqubo Yokuqapha Ikhwalithi Yamanzi Okuphuza Emphakathini

units.source_text: Purpose: This procedure explains how field teams collect and record drinking water samples so that results are reliable and traceable to the correct site.
units.target_text: Inhloso: Le nqubo ichaza ukuthi amaqembu asemkhakheni awaqoqa futhi awarekhoda kanjani amasampula amanzi okuphuza ukuze imiphumela ithembeke futhi ilandeleke endaweni efanele.

units.source_text: Scope: It applies to routine samples collected from reservoirs, treatment outlets, and public taps. The procedure does not cover emergency chemical spills or laboratory instrument calibration.
units.target_text: Ububanzi: Isebenza kumasampula avamile aqoqwa emadamu, ezindaweni zokukhipha amanzi okwelashwa, nasempompini zomphakathi. Le nqubo ayihlanganisi ukuvuza kwamakhemikhali okuphuthumayo noma ukulinganisa amathuluzi aselabhorethri.

flags.issue: The term 'treatment outlets' is translated descriptively; confirm if a standard isiZulu term exists in municipal water operations.

units.source_text: Responsibilities: The team leader checks that each technician has PBT, clean sample bottles, and a calibrated meter. Technicians are responsible for completing the Chain of Custody Form QMS-07 and reporting unsafe conditions.
units.target_text: Izemfanelo: Umholi weqembu uhlola ukuthi uchwepheshe ngamunye une-PBT, amabhodlela amasampula ahlanzekile, nemitha elinganisiwe. Ochwepheshe banomthwalo wemfanelo wokuqedela Ifomu Lokulandelelwa Kokutholakala Kwezinto (QMS-07) nokubika izimo ezingaphephile.

flags.issue: The acronym 'PBT' is not expanded in the source and its meaning is unclear; a human reviewer must confirm the intended term (e.g., personal protective equipment) and its isiZulu equivalent.
The term 'Chain of Custody Form' is translated descriptively; confirm if a standard isiZulu term is used by the municipality.

units.source_text: Procedure: Before collecting a sample, allow the tap to run for 2 minutes. Rinse the probe with clean water, but do not rinse a sterile microbiological bottle. Record pH and turbidity in NTU at the site. Samples must be placed in a cooler between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius.
units.target_text: Inqubo: Ngaphambi kokuqoqa isampula, vumela impompi igijime imizuzu emi-2. Geza iphrobu ngamanzi ahlanzekile, kodwa ungagezi ibhodlela elinyumba elingenawo amagciwane. Bhala i-pH nokufiphala (turbidity) nge-NTU endaweni. Amasampula kufanele abekwe esiqandisini phakathi kuka-2 no-8 degrees Celsius.

flags.issue: The term 'probe' is transliterated as 'iphrobu'; confirm if a more standard term is used in the field.

units.source_text: Data recording: Write the site code, date, time, and sampler initials on both the bottle and QMS-07. Corrections must be made with a single line through the error; correction fluid is not allowed. The reason for any missing reading must be stated.
units.target_text: Ukurekhoda idatha: Bhala ikhodi yendawo, usuku, isikhathi, nama-inishiyali zomuntu othatha isampula kubhodlela naku-QMS-07. Ukulungisa amaphutha kufanele kwenziwe ngomugqa owodwa phezu kwephutha; ukusebenzisa uketshezi lokulungisa akukuvunyelwe. Isizathu sanoma yikuphi ukungafundi okungekho kufanele sishiwo.

flags.issue: The phrase 'sampler initials' is translated descriptively; confirm if a shorter standard term exists.

units.source_text: Escalation: If pH is below 6.5 or above 9.5, or turbidity is higher than 1 NTU, phone the team leader immediately. Do not tell the community that the water is safe or unsafe until the authorised official has reviewed the result.
units.target_text: Ukuphakamisa udaba: Uma i-pH ingaphansi kuka-6.5 noma ingaphezu kuka-9.5, noma ukufiphala kuphakeme kuno-1 NTU, shayela umholi weqembu ngokushesha. Ungatsheli umphakathi ukuthi amanzi aphephile noma awaphephile kuze kube yilapho isikhulu esigunyaziwe sibuyekeze umphumela.
